#!/usr/bin/env bash
# P106B_Stage4flW0_native_broad4_recovery_cpu: new namespace after malformed root idle receipt; numerical experiment unchanged.
# Same native Q/F parents, Broad22528 rows/four passes704; Muon/L0/clip1/micro8 accum16/checkpoint-on.
# CPU/metadata and a successful child are not model quality; old failed evidence remains immutable.
set -euo pipefail
cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")"
source scripts/shell/tinylm_env.sh
python_bin="$(tinylm_python)"
if [[ $# -ne 0 ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' '[STOP] This immutable stage accepts no positional arguments.' >&2
    exit 8
fi
run_stamp="$(date +%H%M%S)"
log="test_result/101_log_$(date +%Y%m%d)_P106B_Stage4flW0_native_broad4_recovery_cpu_${run_stamp}.txt"
if [[ -e "$log" || -L "$log" ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' '[STOP] Existing raw preserved; use a new stage.' >&2
    exit 8
fi
"$python_bin" -B -X utf8 scripts/runlog.py --name P106B_Stage4flW0_native_broad4_recovery_cpu_"$run_stamp" --num 101 --note 'Recovery-v2 isolated namespace; old failed proof/activity/source untouched. Same original22528/native QF/704/continuous optimizer; actual-worker14400/eval1200/record600,21st17KST authority/train14KST. No stdin. Root fresh300s UTC/monotonic idle and complete info code-map per cost route; never a single-file SHA. Current prepare worker cap600s. Actual train/cost require closed worker then readonly verification. Every public file below20MB; technical completion is not intelligence.'
"$python_bin" -B -X utf8 scripts/runlog.py --name P106B_Stage4flW0_native_broad4_recovery_cpu_"$run_stamp" --num 101 -- "$python_bin" -B -X utf8 scripts/diag_p106b_native_broad4_recovery.py --mode prepare --max-wall-sec 600 --execute
